subject: general
question: The Government of India, on January 2022, approved the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme 'National Programme on Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) Battery Storage with a budgetary outlay of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is "__**Rs. 18,100 crore**__".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Government of India has allocated 18,100 crore to the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme **"National Programme on Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) Battery Storage"** with the goal of producing **fifty (50) Gigawatt hours (GWh)** of ACC to boost the country's industrial capability.
 
• The initiative's goals include increasing value added at home and making Indian battery production more competitive on a global scale by reducing the levelized cost of production.
 
• The program is made to **not care about the specifics of the battery technology being used**, but rather the result that is being sought.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme

 
 
• To boost domestic manufacturing and cut down on import bills, the union government in March 2020 introduced a PLI scheme that aims to give companies incentives on incremental sales from products manufactured in domestic units. 
 
• The major aim of the scheme was to invite foreign investors to set up their manufacturing units in India.
 
• Similarly, the PLI scheme aims to promote local manufacturers to expand their manufacturing.
 
• Under the Scheme, companies will get incentives on incremental sales from products manufactured in domestic units.
 
• The scheme is implemented by the concerned ministries/departments.
 
• Apart from inviting foreign companies to set shop in India, the scheme also aims to encourage local companies to set up or expand existing manufacturing units.
 
• The Scheme has also been approved for sectors such as automobiles, pharmaceuticals, IT hardware including laptops, mobile phones & telecom equipment, white goods, chemical cells, food processing, etc.
 
• It will expand the present output and will further augur the achievements. For example, Textile Industry in India is one of the largest in the world and this scheme will contribute to further growth of this sector.
 
• PLI Scheme will provide low-cost indigenous raw materials for schemes like Smart City, Digital India mission.
 
• It will give a shot in the arm for the local manufacturing units of our country.
 
• It will create skilled manpower for the masses and reduce the unemployment ratio as these manufacturing sectors are labor-intensive.
